_comment: AF-3 crisis card (server sends the message, title, helplines with Bangla-digit 'display' and the yes/no labels; these keys are only the app's own chrome). Card: cards[].type == 'crisis' (home chat /agent, AI chat send/stream, Agent Core run.crisis, Circle @Assisto result.crisis). Each helpline -> a dial button (needs_confirm: the app dials only on the user's tap). family.offer -> two buttons; 'yes' POSTs /api/v1/crisis/family-alert {token} and shows the server's 'detail'. No ads on this card. All keys NEW. Integrator: bin/arb_apply.py .phaseB/up_afcrisis_arb.json
